extension_protocol.objective_observability: Computable strictly from the pre-trade causal regime journal as of session 252 market open. It requires zero access to portfolio equity curves, daily returns, drawdowns, or running p-values.
extension_protocol.extension_execution: If triggered at session 252, prospective data collection continues session-by-session until the earliest of: (a) N_{def}^{causal} reaches 30, or (b) total sessions T reaches 504.
extension_protocol.stopping_boundary_at_504: If N_{def}^{causal} remains < 30 at session 504 (indicating a sustained 2-year bull market), the trial terminates immediately. Verdict: INCONCLUSIVE (Insufficient defensive regime observations to achieve statistical power).

prohibition_of_interim_optional_stopping.justification: Evaluating d_t sequentially and terminating early when p < 0.05 inflates the false positive rate (Type I error) from 5% to over 20%. Continuous monitoring without alpha-spending corrections invalidates standard inferential statistics.
prohibition_of_interim_optional_stopping.enforcement: The primary hypothesis test is executed exactly once: at the formal conclusion of the trial (session 252, or upon reaching N_{def}=30 during extension, or at session 504).

administrative_extension.purpose: Sample size replenishment due to low market volatility.
administrative_extension.outcome_dependence: ZERO (depends solely on ex-ante regime trigger frequency).
administrative_extension.inferential_impact: Statistically valid; preserves nominal alpha level.

safety_related_discontinuation.name: Catastrophic Circuit Breaker
safety_related_discontinuation.action: Immediate permanent halt of evaluation runner.
safety_related_discontinuation.statistical_treatment: NON-NEUTRAL FAILURE. Must be analyzed as an explicit experimental failure (verdict: REJECT D2). It is not treated as random missing data.

scientific_early_stopping.note: Early termination for scientific efficacy or futility is strictly prohibited because no alpha-spending sequential boundary (e.g. O'Brien-Fleming) is preregistered.

owner_decision_gate.recommendation: Owner should approve this exact 252/504-session protocol in the formal preregistration document.
